description: 针对常见、简单或被滥用的词汇，提供具体、带语境的升级替换方案。

good.comment: “good” 是一个非常基础的词，缺乏学术写作所需的精确性和力度。替换它可以显著提升文章的正式度和说服力。

suggestions.example: Regular exercise has a beneficial effect on mental health.
A flexible work schedule can be advantageous for working parents.
Instead of simply criticising, you should provide constructive feedback.
The new policy has received a favourable response from the public.
This is a highly effective method for reducing costs.

important.comment: “important” 是写作中被过度使用的词汇之一。使用多样化的同义词可以展示更丰富的词汇量。

suggestions.example: The discovery of penicillin was a significant medical breakthrough.
Parental involvement is crucial for a child's development.
Access to clean water is vital for public health.
The main actor plays a pivotal role in the film's success.
It is essential to follow the safety guidelines strictly.

a lot of.comment: “a lot of” 过于口语化。在学术写作中，应使用更正式、更精确的量词。

suggestions.example: Numerous studies have shown a link between smoking and lung cancer.

suggestions.word: a great deal of / a significant amount of
suggestions.example: A great deal of research is still needed in this field.
The library offers a wide range of academic resources.
Natural resources are abundant in this region.

bad.comment: “bad” 同样是一个非常笼统的词。使用更具体的负面词汇能让你的描述更有力、更精确。

suggestions.meaning: 有害的 (常指长期的、潜在的伤害)
suggestions.example: The new policy had a detrimental effect on the local economy.
The project received a lot of negative feedback from the users.

suggestions.meaning: 有害的 (常指直接的伤害)
suggestions.example: The chemical waste is harmful to the environment.
His preparation for the exam was inadequate.
The company suffered from poor management.

show.comment: “show” 是一个常用但略显平淡的动词。在学术写作中，使用更具描述性的动词能更好地表达“展示”或“揭示”的过程。

suggestions.example: The study demonstrates the link between diet and disease.
This chart illustrates the recent trends in population growth.
The survey results indicate a shift in public opinion.
The investigation revealed some unexpected findings.
The novel depicts the struggles of a young immigrant family.

thing.comment: “thing” 是一个非常模糊和口语化的词。为了保证写作的清晰度和学术性，必须用更具体的名词替换它。

suggestions.example: Several factors contributed to the project's success.
We need to address this pressing issue immediately.
The concept of democracy is central to their political system.
One key feature of the new software is its user-friendly interface.
Globalization is a complex economic phenomenon.

big.comment: “big” 是一个非常基础和口语化的形容词。使用更具描述性的词汇可以增加表达的精确度和细致度。

suggestions.example: She inherited a substantial amount of money.
The project required a considerable investment of time and resources.
He has extensive knowledge of ancient history.
The universe is immense, and it holds vast mysteries.
Pollution is a major global problem.

get.comment: “get” 含义广泛，在口语中非常普遍，但对于学术写作来说通常过于口语化。应根据上下文选择更精确的动词。

suggestions.example: You need to obtain a permit before starting construction.
Did you receive my email this morning?
As the evening progressed, the sky became darker.
She worked hard to achieve her academic goals.
I didn't understand the last point he made.

so.comment: “so” 是一个表示结果的常用连词，但偏向口语化。使用其他词汇可以构建更正式、更多样的句式。

suggestions.example: He was late; therefore, he missed the beginning of the presentation.
The company invested heavily in new technology. As a result, its productivity increased.
The evidence was inconclusive; thus, the case was dismissed.
The weather was poor. For this reason, the event was cancelled.

also.comment: 虽然 “also” 在语法上是正确的，但过度使用会使文章显得重复。使用更多样的连接词可以改善文章的逻辑流畅性。

suggestions.example: In addition, the report highlights the need for more funding.
The plan is risky. Moreover, it is extremely expensive.
You should review your notes. Likewise, it's important to do the practice questions.
Not only is the new system more efficient, but it is also more secure.

use.comment: “use” 是一个功能性动词，但往往可以通过更具体的词汇来增强表达效果，说明“如何”使用。

suggestions.meaning: 利用 (强调有效或创新的使用)
suggestions.example: We must utilize all available resources to complete the project.
The company employs advanced techniques in its manufacturing process.
The skills he learned at university can be applied to his new job.

suggestions.meaning: 利用 (尤指为了获得优势)
suggestions.example: She is skilled at leveraging her network to find new opportunities.

interesting.comment: “interesting” 是一个非常主观且模糊的词。具体说明某事物为何有趣，可以使你的写作更具说服力和分析性。

suggestions.example: The documentary about deep-sea life was absolutely fascinating.

suggestions.meaning: 引人入胜的，令人信服的
suggestions.example: She presented a compelling argument for reform.
It was a thought-provoking film that stayed with me for days.
The origins of the ancient manuscript remain an intriguing mystery.
The study's most noteworthy finding was the speed of the reaction.

think.comment: 在表达观点时，“think” 非常普遍。使用更具体的动词可以清晰地表明你的思考方式，例如是相信、分析还是建议。

suggestions.example: I believe that education is the key to a better future.

suggestions.meaning: 主张，认为 (带有论证意味)
suggestions.example: The author argues that the current policy is ineffective.
Some economists contend that a recession is imminent.
The data suggests a correlation between the two variables.
He posited a new theory to explain the phenomenon.

say.comment: “say” 是一个中性且容易重复的动词，常用于转述信息。使用更具描述性的词汇可以更好地传达陈述背后的语气和意图。

suggestions.example: The witness stated that he saw the suspect leave the building.
He asserted his innocence in front of the jury.
The company claims its product can cure hair loss.
She briefly mentioned her travel plans for the summer.
The speaker emphasized the importance of teamwork.

but.comment: “but” 是一个基础的连词，但过度使用会使文章显得简单。使用多样的转折词可以增强逻辑的流畅度和复杂性。

suggestions.meaning: 然而 (更正式，常用于句首)
suggestions.example: The task was difficult; however, they managed to complete it on time.
There was little chance of success; nevertheless, they decided to proceed.
The city offers many job opportunities. On the other hand, the cost of living is very high.

suggestions.meaning: 尽管 (后接名词或动名词)
suggestions.example: Despite the bad weather, the match went ahead.

suggestions.meaning: 然而，鉴于 (用于直接对比)
suggestions.example: My brother loves spicy food, while I prefer milder dishes.

problem.comment: “problem” 是一个通用词。在正式写作中，使用更具体的词汇能更好地定义困难的性质。

suggestions.meaning: 议题，问题 (常指需讨论解决的)
suggestions.example: Climate change is a global issue that requires immediate attention.

suggestions.meaning: 挑战 (强调困难但可克服)
suggestions.example: Funding remains the biggest challenge for the new startup.
A lack of experience can be a major obstacle to finding a job.
She faced the dilemma of choosing between her career and her family.
The political situation introduced a new complication into the negotiations.

very.comment: “very” 是一个较弱的强度副词。通常，用一个更强、更精确的形容词来代替 “very + 形容词” 会使表达更有力。

suggestions.example: After the marathon, he was completely exhausted.
The new skyscraper is enormous.
She gave an outstanding performance in the play.
It is crucial that we arrive on time.
He was furious when he discovered the mistake.

new.comment: “new” 含义清晰但缺乏细节。根据上下文，可以用更生动的词来描述“新”的特质。

suggestions.example: The company is known for its innovative approach to product design.
The museum features a collection of contemporary art.
Please refer to the revised edition of the textbook.
Her research on gene editing was truly groundbreaking.

and.comment: “and” 是最基础的连接词。在列举或连接观点时，使用不同的词汇可以使句子结构更丰富，逻辑关系更清晰。

suggestions.example: The new policy affects businesses as well as individual consumers.
In addition to his full-time job, he runs a small online store.
A detailed report was submitted along with the application form.

suggestions.meaning: 此外，而且 (用于补充论点)
suggestions.example: The source code is well-documented. Furthermore, it has an extensive test suite.

help.comment: “help” 是一个好词，但通常比较笼统。使用更具体的动词可以清晰地描述“如何”提供帮助，使行为更具体。

suggestions.example: The junior researcher will assist the professor with the experiment.
A good teacher facilitates learning rather than just giving answers.
The government provides funding to support small businesses.
The new software will enable us to process data more efficiently.
Regular exercise contributes to overall health and well-being.

make.comment: “make” 是一个万能但通常偏口语化的动词。在许多语境下，替换它可以增加表达的精确度和正式性。

suggestions.example: The artist uses recycled materials to create beautiful sculptures.

suggestions.meaning: 产生 (常用于想法、收入、能量)
suggestions.example: The marketing campaign is expected to generate significant revenue.
The factory can produce 1,000 units per day.
They plan to construct a new bridge over the river.
The unexpected news rendered him speechless.

people.comment: “people” 是一个极其笼统的词。根据上下文使用更具体的名词，可以让你的写作更准确、更专业。

suggestions.example: The new law protects the rights of individuals.
The government should be accountable to the public.
Local residents have complained about the noise.
All participants in the study were asked to sign a consent form.
The company collects feedback from its users to improve the product.

small.comment: 和 “big” 一样，“small” 是一个基础的描述词。更精确的词汇能更好地传达其规模、重要性或具体特征。

suggestions.example: He made a few minor adjustments to the plan.
There has been a slight increase in prices this month.
She achieved modest success with her first novel.
The study was based on a limited number of samples.
He lives in a compact apartment in the city center.

look at.comment: 动词短语 “look at” 通常较为口语化。更正式或更具描述性的动词能更好地表达观察、检查或分析的行为。

suggestions.example: The auditors will examine the company's financial records.
In this essay, I will analyze the main themes of the novel.
Scientists observe the behavior of animals in their natural habitat.
The committee will review all the applications.
We need to consider all the options before making a decision.

explain.comment: “explain” 是一个清晰的动词，但其替代词可以增加关于“如何”解释的细节，例如通过澄清、举例或详细阐述。

suggestions.example: Could you clarify your last point? I didn't quite understand.
The CEO was asked to elaborate on the company's future plans.
The first chapter of the book defines the key terms used.
The witness described the suspect in great detail.
Let me give you an example to illustrate my point.

idea.comment: “idea” 是个常用词，但替换成更具体的词可以更好地表达这个“想法”的性质：它是一个概念、一个建议还是一个观点？

suggestions.example: The concept of gravity is fundamental to physics.
He rejected the notion that success is measured by wealth alone.
From a historical perspective, the event was a turning point.
The committee is now considering your proposal.
The scientist developed a new theory about the origin of the universe.

right / wrong.comment: “right” 和 “wrong” 在道德或事实判断上过于绝对和简单。在学术和分析性写作中，使用更严谨的词汇能体现更细致的考量。

suggestions.example: Your calculations are accurate.
This is not an appropriate time to discuss the issue.
Her anger was completely justified.

suggestions.meaning: 不正确的 / 不精确的
suggestions.example: The information in the report was inaccurate.
His casual remarks were inappropriate for such a formal occasion.
The methodology of the study was seriously flawed.

start / begin.comment: 这两个词本身没有问题，但使用更正式或更具描述性的动词能更好地设定基调，尤其是在描述一个过程或事件的开端时。

suggestions.example: The ceremony will commence at 10:00 AM sharp.
The government has initiated a new program to boost the economy.

suggestions.meaning: 启动，发起 (常用于项目、产品)
suggestions.example: The company plans to launch its new smartphone next month.
The university was established in the 19th century.

suggestions.meaning: 着手，开始 (常用于旅程、事业)
suggestions.example: After graduating, she embarked on a career in journalism.

end / finish.comment: 与 “start” 类似，这些词清晰常用，但其替代词能提供更复杂或更具决定性的结尾语调。

suggestions.example: The report concludes that the new policy has been effective.

suggestions.meaning: 终止，终结 (常用于合同、服务)
suggestions.example: They decided to terminate the agreement due to breach of contract.
He needs to complete the final year of his degree.
The factory ceased operations last year.
Months of hard work culminated in a successful product launch.

because.comment: “because” 是表达原因最常见的方式，但容易导致简单的句式。使用替代词可以增加句式多样性和正式度。

suggestions.example: The flight was delayed due to adverse weather conditions.
As it was getting late, we decided to head back.
He was rejected on the grounds that he lacked the necessary experience.
In light of recent events, we have decided to cancel the meeting.
The reason for the delay is that the train's engine malfunctioned.

reason.comment: “reason” 是一个核心名词，但更具体的词汇可以阐明你所描述的原因类型，例如是逻辑、动机还是因素。

suggestions.meaning: 原因，起因 (强调直接的因果)
suggestions.example: The main cause of the accident was driver error.

suggestions.meaning: 因素 (强调是多个原因之一)
suggestions.example: Economic factors played a significant role in the decision.

suggestions.meaning: 根本原因 / 正当理由 (强调决策背后的逻辑)
suggestions.example: What is the rationale behind this new strategy?
His motivation for studying hard was to get into a good university.
There is no scientific basis for these claims.

effect.comment: “effect” 是表示结果的通用词。使用更具体的名词可以更生动地描述结果的性质、范围或重要性。

suggestions.meaning: 后果 (常带有重大或负面的含义)
suggestions.example: The environmental consequences of deforestation are severe.

suggestions.meaning: 影响 (通常指强大、直接的作用)
suggestions.example: The new technology has had a huge impact on the industry.

suggestions.meaning: 结果，结局 (强调过程的最终结果)
suggestions.example: It is still too early to predict the outcome of the election.

suggestions.meaning: 反响，后果 (常指间接、意料之外的连锁反应)
suggestions.example: The decision to close the factory had serious repercussions for the local community.
The study has profound implications for future research.

like (for giving examples).comment: 在口语中用 “like” 来举例非常普遍，但对于学术和专业写作而言则过于口语化，必须替换。

suggestions.example: Many countries are facing similar issues. For example, Germany is dealing with an aging population.
She enjoys outdoor activities, such as hiking and cycling.
The price is all-inclusive, including flights, accommodation, and meals.

suggestions.meaning: 即，也就是 (用于引出具体细节)
suggestions.example: We need to focus on the main problem, namely, the lack of funding.
Urban renewal often leads to gentrification; the downtown district is a case in point.

try.comment: “try” 是一个表示尝试的通用动词。更具体的动词可以传达更多关于所涉努力和方法的信息。

suggestions.example: He will attempt to break the world record tomorrow.

suggestions.meaning: 努力，奋斗 (强调付出了巨大努力)
suggestions.example: We must strive to meet the highest standards.
The organization seeks to promote cultural exchange.

suggestions.meaning: 从事，承担 (通常指较大的任务或项目)
suggestions.example: She is about to undertake a major research project.
Please make an effort to arrive on time.

really / actually.comment: 这两个词在口语中用于加强语气，但在正式写作中往往是冗余的。删除它们或使用更强的词汇通常是更好的选择。

suggestions.example: The difference in scale is vast.

suggestions.word: actually, it is... -> It is, in fact,...
suggestions.example: It is, in fact, the most effective method available.

suggestions.meaning: 真正地，确实地 (用于强调真诚)
suggestions.example: He is a genuinely kind person.

suggestions.meaning: 确实，实际上 (用于证实或强调)
suggestions.example: The results were very good indeed.
'The movie was really good' becomes 'The movie was excellent.'

change.comment: “change” 是一个中性的通用动词。更具体的动词可以传达变化的性质、方向和幅度，使描述更加生动。

suggestions.meaning: 彻底改变，使改观 (强调巨大、根本的变化)
suggestions.example: The internet has transformed the way we communicate.
They had to alter their plans due to the bad weather.

suggestions.meaning: 修改，调整 (通常指较小的、技术性的改动)
suggestions.example: The design was modified to improve its efficiency.
Many businesses have had to adapt to the new economic climate.
Her thinking has evolved over the years.

improve.comment: “improve” 是一个积极但笼统的词。使用更具描述性的动词可以突出是哪个方面得到了改善，例如是功能、效率还是体验。

suggestions.meaning: 增强，提升 (价值、品质、体验)
suggestions.example: The new features are designed to enhance the user experience.
We need to optimize our workflow to reduce costs.
The author continued to refine her manuscript until it was perfect.
The company is taking steps to strengthen its market position.
It's time to upgrade our computer systems.

find / find out.comment: 这两个词常用于发现信息，但在正式或研究语境中，使用更精确的动词可以更好地反映发现过程的严谨性。

suggestions.meaning: 发现 (通常是首次发现未知事物)
suggestions.example: Scientists have discovered a new species of frog.

suggestions.meaning: 确定，查明 (经过研究或计算后得出结论)
suggestions.example: The investigation will seek to determine the cause of the accident.

suggestions.meaning: 查明，弄清 (非常正式，强调确保真实性)
suggestions.example: The police are trying to ascertain the man's identity.
The study aims to identify the key factors behind this trend.
The documents uncovered a history of corruption.

part.comment: “part” 是一个非常笼统的词，指整体中的一部分。更具体的名词可以增加清晰度和技术精确性。

suggestions.meaning: 组成部分 / 要素 (常指系统的核心构成)
suggestions.example: The CPU is a crucial component of a computer.
The final section of the report summarizes the findings.

suggestions.meaning: 方面 (强调问题的不同层面)
suggestions.example: We must consider every aspect of the problem.
A significant portion of the budget was allocated to research.

suggestions.meaning: 模块，单元 (常用于课程、软件)
suggestions.example: The course consists of five distinct modules.

way / method.comment: 这两个词常用于描述做事的方式。其替代词可以更具体地表达是策略、技术还是程序，听起来也更专业。

suggestions.meaning: 方法，途径 (强调看问题的角度和处理方式)
suggestions.example: The company has adopted a new approach to marketing.
The artist uses a unique painting technique.
You must follow the standard safety procedure.

suggestions.meaning: 策略 (为实现长期目标的计划)
suggestions.example: The government has developed a long-term strategy for economic growth.

suggestions.meaning: 方式，方法 (强调行为方式)
suggestions.example: He conducted the interview in a very professional manner.

in conclusion.comment: 这是一个正确但被过度使用的结论开头语。使用多样化的语言可以让你的总结段落更自然、更有力。

suggestions.example: In summary, the key findings suggest a need for policy change.
In short, the project was a resounding success.
Ultimately, the decision rests with the manager.
Taking everything into account, we believe our proposal is the most viable.

suggestions.word: It is clear from the above that...
suggestions.example: It is clear from the above that a new approach is needed.

seem.comment: “seem” 在表达不确定性或外观时很有用，但其他词可以提供更细微的差别或更客观、正式的语气。

suggestions.example: The results appear to be consistent with our hypothesis.
His calm demeanor gives the impression of confidence.
It is apparent that further research is needed.

suggestions.meaning: 表明，暗示 (用于描述证据)
suggestions.example: The evidence suggests that he is innocent.

give.comment: “give” 是一个极其常见的动词。用更具体的动词替换它，可以使动作的意图更清晰、更正式，例如是提供信息、授予机会还是贡献想法。

suggestions.meaning: 提供 (最常用的正式替代词)
suggestions.example: The report provides a detailed analysis of the market.
The company offered him a senior position.

suggestions.meaning: 呈现，陈述 (展示信息、发现)
suggestions.example: She will present her findings at the conference.
The foundation granted them $1 million for their research.
He contributed some valuable ideas to the discussion.

need.comment: “need” 强烈地表达了必要性，但在学术或专业语境中，使用更正式或细致的语言可以更好地说明需求的性质。

suggestions.meaning: 需要，要求 (正式，强调客观条件)
suggestions.example: This position requires at least five years of experience.
It is necessary to update the software immediately.
The situation demands immediate action.

suggestions.meaning: 牵涉，需要 (强调作为必然结果)
suggestions.example: A leadership role entails a great deal of responsibility.
The decline in sales will necessitate a change in strategy.

ask.comment: “ask” 是一个表示询问的通用词。更具体的动词可以传达问题的语气、背景和目的，例如是正式询问、请求还是质询。

suggestions.example: I am writing to inquire about your current job openings.
The user requested more information about the product.
The police questioned the witness for two hours.
You should consult a financial advisor before making any investments.

suggestions.meaning: 查询，提问 (常用于书面或技术场景)
suggestions.example: Our system can query the database for specific records.

clear.comment: “clear” 是一个形容某事易于理解的常用词。更具描述性的词汇可以增加强调或正式感，例如是逻辑清晰还是表达明确。

suggestions.example: The instructions need to be explicit to avoid any confusion.
It was apparent from their faces that they were disappointed.

suggestions.meaning: 毫不含糊的，没有歧义的
suggestions.example: The contract language must be unambiguous.

suggestions.meaning: 清晰易懂的，明朗的 (常用于写作或解释)
suggestions.example: He is known for his lucid writing style.
The process is surprisingly straightforward.

tell.comment: 和 “say” 一样，“tell” 是一个常见的转述动词。使用更具体的动词可以表明沟通的方式或目的，例如是通知、指示还是建议。

suggestions.example: Please inform us of any changes to your contact details.

suggestions.meaning: 通知，告知 (常用于官方通知)
suggestions.example: All applicants will be notified of the results by email.
His doctor advised him to rest and drink plenty of fluids.
The manager instructed the team to complete the report by Friday.
He recounted his adventures to an eager audience.

rich / poor.comment: 这些是基础且有时带有感情色彩的术语。在社会、经济或学术讨论中，更中性、更精确的语言更受青睐。

suggestions.example: They live in an affluent neighborhood.
The country has become a prosperous nation.
The war left thousands of people destitute.
The policy provides tax relief for low-income families.

suggestions.meaning: 处境不利的 / 贫困的
suggestions.example: The program aims to help children from disadvantaged backgrounds.

job.comment: “job” 是一个常用但非正式的词。在简历、求职信等专业文件中，使用更具体或正式的术语通常更好。

suggestions.example: She has been appointed to the position of Marketing Director.
He chose teaching as his profession.
Please state your name, age, and occupation.

suggestions.meaning: (认为适合自己的)职业，使命感
suggestions.example: For her, nursing wasn't just a job; it was a vocation.
He is currently seeking full-time employment.

live in.comment: 这个动词短语非常普遍，但单个词的替代品听起来可以更正式或更具文学性。

suggestions.example: He currently resides in a suburb of Paris.
The island is inhabited by a diverse range of wildlife.
They dwell in a small cottage in the countryside.
Our company is based in Singapore.
The tenants will occupy the apartment starting next month.

see.comment: “see” 是一个基础的感知动词。更具体的动词可以澄清你的意思是物理上的“看见”、智力上的“理解”还是作为“目击者”。

suggestions.meaning: 感知，察觉 (强调认知过程)
suggestions.example: She perceived a subtle change in his attitude.
Several people witnessed the accident.

suggestions.meaning: 观察 (带有目的性和细致性)
suggestions.example: The scientist will observe the specimen under a microscope.

suggestions.meaning: 注意到 (强调无意中的发现)
suggestions.example: I didn't notice that he had left the room.
He could not envision a future without her.

happy.comment: “happy” 是一个表达积极情绪的通用词。更具描述性的词汇可以传达快乐的强度和性质，例如是满足、喜悦还是狂喜。

suggestions.example: I am delighted to accept your invitation.

suggestions.meaning: 充满喜悦的 / 开朗的
suggestions.example: It was a joyful reunion of old friends.
He was content with his simple life in the village.

suggestions.meaning: 欣喜若狂的 / 兴高采烈的
suggestions.example: She was elated to hear that she had won the scholarship.

suggestions.meaning: 欢欣鼓舞的 (常用于庆祝胜利)
suggestions.example: The fans were jubilant after their team's victory.

sad.comment: 和“happy”一样，“sad”是一个基础的情感描述词。使用更具体的词汇可以更清晰地描绘负面情绪的层次，例如是悲伤、沮丧还是忧郁。

suggestions.example: She had a sorrowful expression on her face.
He felt miserable after failing the exam.

suggestions.meaning: 忧郁的 (一种深沉、持久的悲伤)
suggestions.example: A feeling of melancholy descended upon him as evening fell.
They were disheartened by the lack of progress.

suggestions.meaning: 忧郁的，严肃的 (常用于描述气氛)
suggestions.example: The news cast a somber mood over the gathering.

get worse.comment: 这个动词短语在口语中非常普遍。在正式写作中，单个词的、更正式的替代品，如 'deteriorate'，更受欢迎。

suggestions.meaning: 恶化 (常指质量、健康、状况)
suggestions.example: The patient's condition began to deteriorate overnight.
The economic situation is expected to worsen before it improves.
The company's profits have declined in recent years.
The debate quickly degenerated into personal attacks.
The protests escalated into a full-blown crisis.

always / never.comment: 这两个绝对副词语气非常强烈且通常不准确。在学术和分析性写作中，最好使用更严谨、更细致的频率语言，以避免以偏概全。

suggestions.example: The climate is generally warm and humid.
She has consistently delivered high-quality work.
Such opportunities rarely arise.
It is highly unlikely that he will agree to the terms.
There are almost never any exceptions to this rule.

fast / slow.comment: 这是描述速度的基础词汇。更具体或生动的语言能让你的写作更吸引人、更精确，例如是“迅速的”还是“逐渐的”。

suggestions.meaning: 迅速的 (常用于变化、发展)
suggestions.example: The city has undergone rapid development.

suggestions.meaning: 迅速的 / 及时的 (常用于行动、回复)
suggestions.example: Thank you for your prompt reply.
There has been a gradual improvement in his health.
The project is making slow but steady progress.
We took a leisurely stroll through the park.

let.comment: “let”是表示允许的常用动词，但可能显得非正式。在专业或官方场合，通常使用更正式的替代词。

suggestions.example: The new rules permit employees to work from home two days a week.
This pass enables you to access all restricted areas.
Only senior management can authorize this level of expenditure.
The IT department will grant you access to the server.

have / has (to indicate features).comment: 当用于描述特征或内容时（如“报告有三个部分”），“have”虽然语法正确但略显简单。使用更具描述性的动词能使写作更生动、更主动。

suggestions.example: The document contains sensitive information.

suggestions.meaning: 包括 (作为整体的一部分)
suggestions.example: The tour includes a visit to the local museum.
The new phone features a more powerful camera.

suggestions.meaning: 拥有 (正式，常用于品质、特征)
suggestions.example: She possesses a remarkable ability to solve complex problems.
The committee consists of ten members.

want.comment: “want” 直接表达欲望，在专业或学术写作中有时可能过于口语化或直白。使用更委婉或正式的表达方式通常更受欢迎。

suggestions.example: I would like to apply for the scholarship program.
The company seeks to expand its operations in Asia.
He desired to make a difference in the world.
We intend to complete the project by the end of the year.
This study aims to investigate the effects of climate change.

choose.comment: “choose”是做选择的标准动词。在官方或分析性语境中，使用更正式的替代词可以暗示选择的严肃性或过程的复杂性。

suggestions.meaning: 选择 (暗示经过仔细考虑和筛选)
suggestions.example: The committee will select the best candidate for the job.

suggestions.meaning: 选择 (常指在一系列选项中做出选择)
suggestions.example: Many consumers opt for products with eco-friendly packaging.
Have you decided on a color for the walls?
She elected to continue her studies at a different university.
Given the choice, I would prefer to work from home.

different.comment: “different” 陈述了差异，但没有描述其性质。更精确的形容词能让你的比较更生动、信息更丰富。

suggestions.example: The two concepts are distinct and should not be confused.
The conference attracted a diverse group of participants.
His hobbies are quite varied.

suggestions.meaning: 不相似的 / 对比鲜明的
suggestions.example: Their political views are completely dissimilar.
This species of bird is unique to the island.

same.comment: 和“different”一样，“same”是一个基础的比较词。使用更成熟的语言可以提高你比较的质量，使其更具说服力。

suggestions.example: The two samples were identical in every respect.

suggestions.meaning: 相等的，等同的 (在价值、功能上)
suggestions.example: A degree from that college is equivalent to one from a top university.
The quality of their work is comparable to ours.
All the rooms have a uniform style of decoration.
The structure of an atom is sometimes considered analogous to that of a solar system.

sure.comment: “sure” 是表达确定性的常用方式，但听起来可能非正式。在需要表达坚定立场或高度确定性时，通常需要更正式的语言。

suggestions.example: I am confident that we will succeed.
It is certain that prices will continue to rise.
She is convinced of his innocence.
Are you positive you locked the door?
She is undoubtedly the best person for the job.

picture.comment: “picture” 是一个通用术语。在艺术、数据分析或媒体等特定语境中，使用更精确的术语（如图表、照片、插图）是专业性的体现。

suggestions.example: The satellite sent back high-resolution images of the planet.
The article was accompanied by a black-and-white photograph.
This diagram illustrates how the machine works.
The children's book has beautiful illustrations.
The film's depiction of historical events has been criticized.

about (to describe a topic).comment: 使用“about”来介绍主题（如“a book about history”）非常普遍但可能过于简单。更正式的介词或短语可以提升你写作的学术气息。

suggestions.example: I am writing to you regarding the recent policy change.
He wrote a detailed report on the subject of urban planning.
It is a documentary that explores the challenges of deep-sea diving.
Her latest publication is a study of ancient Roman architecture.
We have gathered all the documents pertaining to this case.

understand.comment: “understand” 是一个清晰常用的动词。然而，更具体的词可以传达理解的深度或性质，例如是初步掌握还是彻底领会。

suggestions.meaning: 理解，领会 (强调更深、更彻底的理解)
suggestions.example: He was unable to comprehend the complexity of the issue.

suggestions.meaning: 理解，掌握 (常用于抓住要点或难懂的概念)
suggestions.example: She quickly grasped the main principles of the theory.
They recognized the need for immediate action.

suggestions.meaning: 理解，意识到 (常用于理解某事的价值、重要性或难度)
suggestions.example: I appreciate the challenges you are facing.

suggestions.meaning: 理解，看穿 (用于非常难以理解的事物)
suggestions.example: I can't fathom why he would do such a thing.

hard / difficult.comment: 这是描述困难的标准词。更具体的替代词可以解释某事困难的“原因”，例如是因其复杂、要求高还是需要巨大努力。

suggestions.meaning: 有挑战性的 (暗示困难但能激发人)
suggestions.example: It was a challenging but rewarding project.
Being a doctor is a very demanding profession.
The instructions were too complex to follow.

suggestions.meaning: 艰苦的 / 费力的 (强调需要巨大努力)
suggestions.example: He embarked on an arduous journey across the mountains.

suggestions.meaning: 棘手的，难办的 (略带非正式)
suggestions.example: Parking in the city center can be tricky.

go up / increase.comment: 这两个动词很适合描述上升趋势，但更生动或具体的动词（如“飙升”或“加速”）可以增加分析的深度和画面的冲击力。

suggestions.example: Temperatures are expected to climb throughout the week.
Stock prices soared after the announcement.
Inflation has accelerated in recent months.

suggestions.meaning: (逐步)升高，增强 (常用于冲突、危机)
suggestions.example: The conflict has escalated into a full-scale war.
The company plans to expand its operations overseas.

go down / decrease.comment: “go up”的反义词。使用更具描述性的语言（如“暴跌”或“减弱”）可以更好地说明下降趋势的性质和速度。

suggestions.example: The company's market share has declined significantly.
The stock market plummeted following the news.
His enthusiasm for the project has diminished over time.
After the storm, the winds gradually subsided.
The market for traditional cameras has shrunk dramatically.

wrong (as in an error).comment: 在描述错误时，“wrong”可能显得直白且带有指责意味。更精确的词可以在不听起来过于批判的情况下指明错误的性质。

suggestions.meaning: 不正确的 / 不精确的
suggestions.example: The figures in this report are inaccurate.
I'm afraid you are mistaken about the date.

suggestions.meaning: 有缺陷的 (常指逻辑、论证)
suggestions.example: His argument is fundamentally flawed.
He came to an erroneous conclusion based on the limited data.

suggestions.meaning: 有错误的，有缺陷的 (常用于设备、系统)
suggestions.example: The accident was caused by a faulty brake system.

worker / boss.comment: 这是职业角色的常用但非正式术语。在商务和正式写作中，使用更正式和具体的头衔（如雇员、主管）是标准做法。

suggestions.example: The company has over 500 employees.
All personnel are required to attend the safety training.
Please submit your report to your immediate supervisor.
The company is one of the largest employers in the region.
The decision was made by the board of directors.

goal / aim.comment: 这是两个不错的标准词。替代词可以提供不同的重点，例如是可衡量的具体指标、长期的愿景还是项目的根本意图。

suggestions.meaning: 目标，目的 (常指具体的、可衡量的)
suggestions.example: Our primary objective is to increase sales by 10%.
The team successfully met its production target for the quarter.
Her ambition was to become a successful entrepreneur.
The company's vision is to be a global leader in sustainable technology.
The purpose of this research is to test the new hypothesis.

agree.comment: “agree” 是表达赞同的直接方式。在学术写作中，更细致的语言可以显示赞同的程度或依据，使立场更具说服力。

suggestions.example: The committee concurred with the reviewer's assessment.
The results are in accordance with our initial hypothesis.
I fully endorse the proposal to improve public transport.
Many experts share the view that the policy needs to be revised.

suggestions.meaning: 承认 (常用于承认对方论点中的合理部分)
suggestions.example: I acknowledge your point about the budget constraints, but I still believe we should proceed.

disagree.comment: 和“agree”一样，“disagree”很直接。在议论文中，更成熟的措辞能让你的反对意见听起来更理性、更具分析性，而不是简单的情绪对抗。

suggestions.example: Some scientists have challenged the validity of this theory.
He disputed the accuracy of the official report.
While I agree in principle, I must express reservations about the implementation costs.
A counterargument is that this approach ignores potential side effects.
It is questionable whether this method is truly effective in the long run.

I think... (phrase).comment: 用“I think”开头会使你的论点听起来过于主观和个人化，从而削弱其说服力。在正式写作中，应使用更客观、更权威的措辞。

suggestions.example: It can be argued that technology has a significant impact on modern society.
The evidence suggests that this approach is the most effective.
It is apparent that a new strategy is needed to address the issue.
This analysis indicates that the market is shifting towards sustainable products.
'I think the company should invest more' becomes 'The company should invest more to remain competitive.'

support (an idea or claim).comment: “support”是个不错的动词，但更具体的替代词可以阐明证据是“如何”支持一个主张的，例如是通过证实、加强还是验证。

suggestions.example: Further research is needed to substantiate these claims.
The latest data reinforces the initial findings.
The experiment demonstrates the effectiveness of the new drug.
The results of the second study validate the conclusions of the first.
This observation is consistent with the theory of evolution.

nice.comment: “nice” 是一个非常弱且被滥用的积极形容词。用一个更具体、更具描述性的词来替换它，是提升写作生动性最简单有效的方法之一。

suggestions.example: We had a pleasant evening with our friends.

suggestions.meaning: 和蔼可亲的 / 友好的
suggestions.example: He was an amiable host, making everyone feel welcome.
It was very thoughtful of you to bring flowers.

suggestions.meaning: 迷人的 / 令人愉快的
suggestions.example: The cottage was absolutely charming.
She has an impressive command of the English language.

stop.comment: “stop”是个通用动词。更具体的替代词可以表明某事是自然结束、被阻止、被官方终止还是被中断。

suggestions.example: The company has ceased trading due to financial difficulties.
Production was halted due to a shortage of materials.
The new measures are intended to prevent accidents from happening.
The airline has discontinued its direct flight to the city.
His employment was terminated with immediate effect.

old.comment: “old” 是描述年龄的基础词。更具体的词可以澄清某物是古老的、过时的、传统的，还是仅仅指经验丰富。

suggestions.example: We visited an ancient temple in the mountains.
Their computer systems are completely obsolete.
They still use traditional farming methods passed down through generations.

suggestions.meaning: 成熟的 / 年长的 / 资深的
suggestions.example: He is a veteran journalist with decades of experience.
He collects vintage sports cars from the 1960s.
